name: Tokyo Nyoshuu Shuukanjo
source:
Main character is a man of great wealth and power. His new quirk is taking prisoners and training them as slaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
